meta.name: Craft Agents Fresh Desktop
meta.description: A calm, cool-neutral desktop application language with restrained purple accents, low-contrast layers, compact controls, and softly raised utility surfaces.

primary.role: Primary text, icons, and decisive buttons

secondary.role: Selected rows, quiet controls, and grouped surfaces

accent.role: Brand moments, focus emphasis, links, and highlighted data

neutral.usage: Near-white application canvas with foreground-derived translucent layers; stronger neutrals are reserved for text and controls.

color.contrast_strategy: Dark-on-light dominant, with subtle foreground mixes for hierarchy and solid near-black only for primary actions

typography.font_style_notes: Neutral system sans throughout; hierarchy comes from weight, size, and opacity rather than serif contrast.

spacing.section_rhythm: Tight within control groups, 16 to 24px between related sections, and 32 to 48px around primary content regions

layout.grid_system: Flexible application shell with a fixed sidebar and fluid content panel
layout.columns: 12-column content grid inside a sidebar-plus-main shell
layout.alignment_tendency: strict grid with compact left-aligned navigation and calm centered data regions

shape.border_usage: Subtle 1px foreground-derived rings; avoid strong outlines and use borderless hover layers for navigation

elevation.shadow_style: Layered, soft, and extremely restrained with a 1px ambient ring
elevation.depth_cues: Foreground-derived surface tint, ambient ring, and short diffuse shadows

iconography.style: Minimal rounded line icons with occasional duotone accents

motion.entrance_pattern: Short opacity and 4px translate transitions for floating layers
motion.exit_pattern: Faster fade with minimal scale reduction
motion.philosophy: Minimal functional, smooth, and never decorative

components.button_style: 8px corners, 36px default height, near-black primary, 5 percent neutral secondary, subtle color-only hover
components.input_style: 8px corners, quiet tinted fill, ambient 1px ring, compact 36 to 40px height, purple-tinted focus ring
components.card_style: Canvas-colored 8 to 12px rounded surface with a low ambient shadow instead of a visible border
components.navigation_pattern: Fixed cool-neutral sidebar with compact 13px rows, 6px corners, and a 7 percent foreground active fill
components.modal_style: 8 to 12px rounded elevated canvas surface with layered diffuse shadow and subdued overlay
components.list_style: Borderless rows grouped by spacing; hover and active states use 3 to 7 percent foreground fills
components.component_notes: Use opacity and elevation sparingly; reserve pills for filters, tags, and status rather than every action.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: A quiet, well-lit desktop workspace made from lightly stacked sheets

visual_language.whitespace_usage: Comfortable page whitespace paired with compact controls
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: Content and data hold the weight; chrome recedes through low contrast
visual_language.focal_strategy: Progressive emphasis through typographic weight and sparse purple highlights
visual_language.contrast_level: Medium overall with high-contrast text and low-contrast surface separation
visual_language.texture_usage: No texture; depth is produced through translucent color mixes and restrained shadows

composition.hierarchy_method: Typographic hierarchy, opacity steps, and spatial grouping
composition.balance_type: Asymmetric application shell with balanced modular content
composition.flow_direction: Left navigation into top-to-bottom content scanning
composition.grouping_strategy: Proximity first, then gentle surface elevation only where containment helps
composition.negative_space_role: Separates functional zones and prevents dense financial data from feeling heavy

imagery.photo_treatment: Rare; when used, softly rounded and naturally colored
imagery.illustration_style: Simple geometric or line-based utility illustrations
imagery.graphic_elements: Small status dots, muted data fills, clean charts, and restrained purple accents

interaction_feel.feedback_style: Immediate color and opacity response with clear focus rings
interaction_feel.hover_behavior: 2 to 5 percent foreground tint; important surfaces gain a minimal ambient shadow

brand_voice_in_ui.empty_state_approach: Concise explanation plus one obvious next action
brand_voice_in_ui.error_tone: Plain-language and actionable without alarmist styling

overview.fallback_strategy: Disable motion and blur while preserving solid surfaces

background_effects.description: Solid cool-neutral canvas with optional barely tinted local gradients for data context

text_effects.description: Typography remains stable; only loading placeholders may shimmer subtly

image_effects.description: Images use simple opacity and scale hover feedback only when interactive

params.blur_radius: 16px only on floating navigation and overlays

canvas_drawings.description: Charts remain SVG-based application data visualizations

svg_animations.description: Icons use CSS transforms rather than SVG path animation

visual_effects.composite_notes: The signature effect is not spectacle but disciplined layering: a cool near-white canvas, 3 to 7 percent foreground fills, 6 to 8 percent ambient rings, and short diffuse shadows. Respect prefers-reduced-motion and remove backdrop blur where unsupported.
